fields.current: Raises the rainy day fund's limit for required deposits from 10% to 20% of General Fund taxes, saves extra in big capital gains years, keeps deposits from counting against the state spending limit, and extends extra debt payments from 2030 to 2040.

evidence.location: Proposal, Extend and Expand Extra Debt Payments, p. 3
evidence.excerpt: Proposition 2 also requires the state to make extra debt payments through 2040 (instead of through 2030).
exceeds 10 20 percent of the amount of General Fund proceeds of taxes for the fiscal year
to the 2029– 30 2039–40 fiscal year, inclusive

fields.explanation: All four elements match LAO and the text. LAO adds that deposits count toward the limit when the money is withdrawn. Our wording ('keeps deposits from counting against the state spending limit') leaves that out. The rest is accurate. 'Extra debt payments' are limited to pension and retiree health debts.
fields.proposedText: Raises the rainy day fund's limit for required deposits from 10% to 20% of General Fund taxes, saves extra in big capital gains years, counts deposits against the state spending limit only when withdrawn, and extends extra debt payments from 2030 to 2040.
fields.limitations: Text formatting (strikeout and italic) did not come through the reader, so old and new values were inferred from order. LAO wording confirms the direction.

fields.current: No new audit or evaluator found in the text or LAO. Deposits are set by formula in each budget, and suspending them still requires a budget emergency.

evidence.excerpt: the Department of Finance shall provide to the Legislature all of the following information
The annual Budget Act shall include the estimates described in all of the following:
are subject to suspension or reduction pursuant to paragraph (1) of subdivision (a) of Section 22
Third—That Section 22 of Article XVI thereof is amended to read:
During a budget emergency, the state can stop making deposits and/or take money out of the rainy day fund.

fields.explanation: No independent audit or evaluator appears in the text or LAO. But the text adds reporting duties. The Department of Finance must give the Legislature specified information, and each Budget Act must include the deposit estimates. 'Suspending them still requires a budget emergency' matches current law per LAO and the text's cross-reference to Section 22. The measure also amends Section 22 itself, and LAO does not say whether the emergency rules change.
fields.proposedText: No new audit or evaluator. Finance must report deposit estimates to the Legislature and each budget must include them. Deposits can still be suspended only in a budget emergency.
fields.limitations: Formatting loss means it is not certain which Section 20(b) and (h) language is new versus existing. Section 22 amendments were not read in full. Confirm that the emergency trigger is unchanged.
